xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
UML entity model: solid lines are associations; multiplicities describe the named roles, not database integrity. Attributes use [0..1] for optional values and [0..*] for lists. {PK}/{UQ} are schema-key constraints. Enforced relations
and scalar-ID mappings are listed below; cross-service IDs are not foreign keys.
Audio checkpoints UNIQUE(indexAttemptId,segmentNumber). Graph checkpoint/write keys are compound IDs. EmbeddingCacheEntry is intentionally unconnected: cacheKey derives from kind/stable ID/input hash/model and algorithm versions; no
declared FK ties it to a semantic row.
